QuestInfo.name: Jenn's Brother
QuestInfo.0: #p2161003# is in dire need of help. He got trapped by monsters while he was searching for his brother. What is going on at the Lion King's Castle? First, help #p2161003# in #b#m211060200##k.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2161003# asked you to rescue his brother, who is held captive on the Roof of the First Tower. Get to the roof and #brescue #t4032831##k.\n\n#i4032831# #t4032831# #b#c4032831##k/1

#r#eIf you fail the quest, forfeit and do it again.

0.0: My brother is on the Roof of the First Tower. I saw him myself through the keyhole. I couldn't do anything, since #r#o8840002##k would destroy me. But I'm sure you can do it, right? Please?

yes.0: I know you can do it! After all, you got this far without needing anything like my incredible Play Dead technique. Just go through the gate and #brescue my brother#k! Oh, no, hold on, wait. The gate to the Roof of the First Tower is always locked.
yes.1: So, make sure you take this key with you! I managed to steal it when Crocky was sleeping! You can't lose it ever!\r\n

no.0: Wait, you can't either? Then, who can? Do I need to start training?

1.0: Oh, my brother! You rescued my brother! Thank you so much! Okay, hold on... Where is the Return Scroll I've been saving? Hm, did I hide it in my sock?
1.1: (Rummaging...) Ah! Found it. Smells funny... Nevermind! I'll send my brother back to town first...
1.2: I'll give you one, since I have a few more Return Scroll - Nearest Town. Let's go! Huh? You're going to continue exploring here? Whoa, I've never seen someone so bold. Marvelous!
1.3: Thank you for helping! I'll head straight back to town, since you have this well in hand! Be careful on your adventure! Say hello if we meet again in El Nath!

yes.0: Sigh... Since that was my only Return Scroll, I'll have to Play Dead all the way home. Hey, how are you going to return to town? Are you going to fight? Or do you need me to teach you my technique?
yes.1: Whoa, I've never seen someone so bold. Marvelous! Hm, but do you have the keys to the other towers? All the gates are locked, you know. No matter how bold you are, those gates will stop you.
yes.2: I guess I have no choice but to step in. After all, I am #p2161003#, master locksmith! I'll make you the keys you need. My brother shouldn't get into any more trouble...for a while. Yeah, I can spare some time.
yes.3: Aw, shucks, don't look at me all googly-eyed like that! I'm just doing my part, since you helped me.

item.0: Haven't you rescued my brother yet? If you lost the key to the roof, #bforfeit the quest and restart#k. I'll...find a way to give you the key again.
